verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five grasping aggregates.
The grasping aggregates of form, feeling, perception, choices, and consciousness.
These are the five grasping aggregates.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṁ upādānakkhandhānaṁ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya …pe… ayaṁ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.
verses.english: The noble eightfold path should be developed for the direct knowledge, complete understanding, finishing, and giving up of these five grasping aggregates.”
